svg.title: Three occurrences of aw in awyawxawxz
svg.desc: A fragment of the suffix tree of awyawxawxz$, after Gusfield Figure 5.2, with leaves numbered from 0. From the root, the edge aw ends at an internal node, marked by an arrow labeled P = aw. Below it: y awxawxz$ to leaf 0, and x to an internal node with a wxz$ to leaf 3 and z$ to leaf 6. The other edges out of the root (w, x, y, z, $) are cut short.
